family_context_source.selected_text:
Lizardon (Charizard) Mega Battle Tournaments
The Lizardon Mega Battle (also known as the Charizard Mega Battle, as Charizard's Japanese name is Lizardon), was the second official Pokemon TCG tournament.
The Lizardon Mega Battle was held on April 26, 1998.
A series of qualifying tournaments were held across 6 locations in Japan from November 8, 1997 to February 15, 1998.
The top 3 players at each cup from each age division received No.1 - 3 Trainer cards.
No.1 Trainer (Regional Lizardon Mega Battle 1997) (Unnumbered)
No.2 Trainer (Regional Lizardon Mega Battle 1997) (Unnumbered)
No.3 Trainer (Regional Lizardon Mega Battle 1997) (Unnumbered)
The cards were presented in acrylic plaque which designated the cup that they were awarded at.
